scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@nertator/shared && concurrently -k "npm run dev --workspace=@nertator/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=@nertator/desktop"
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build --workspace=@nertator/shared && npm run start --workspace=mobile
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@nertator/shared && npm run build --workspace=@nertator/desktop
scripts.build:mobile: npm run build --workspace=@nertator/shared && npm run build --workspace=mobile
